items.title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
items.description: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say

items.title: Japan in a ‘race against time’ to rescue people trapped beneath rubble after quake
items.description: At least 13 people have been killed after the earthquake struck the island of Kyushu on Tuesday.

items.title: Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq
items.description: US Central Command says proxy groups launched attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.

items.title: Thousands in Spain return home but new heatwave raises wildfire fears
items.description: Spain and France are both braced for the start of the fourth heatwave so far this summer and some fires have continued to burn.

items.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with facilitating terrorism
items.description: The FSB claims the messenger app, created by Pavel Durov, has failed to remove accounts and channels used for recruitment by Ukraine's secret service.

items.title: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct
items.description: The actor and musician faces allegations from 10 women in total who say he mistreated them as teenagers.

items.title: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard killed in crash
items.description: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.
